notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.
